record.context_brief: Albanese fibers for compact Kahler manifolds with pseudo-effective tangent bundle
record.original_question: Let X be a compact Kahler manifold with pseudo-effective tangent bundle. After replacing X by a suitable finite etale cover and considering the Albanese map X -> Alb(X), can one prove that the fiber F has big anti-canonical divisor or is projective, and is this Albanese map an MRC fibration of X?

evidence.quote: Problem 4.5. Let X be a compact Kahler manifold with pseudo-effective tangent bundle. After we replace X with an appropriate finite etale covering of X, we consider the Albanese map X -> Alb(X).
Can we prove that the anti-canonical divisor -KF is big or F is projective?
Is the Albanese map X -> Alb(X) an MRC fibration of X?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $X$ be a compact Kähler manifold whose holomorphic tangent bundle $T_X$ is pseudo-effective (i.e., the tautological line bundle $\mathcal{O}_{\mathbb{P}(T_X^*)}(1)$ on the projectivized cotangent bundle carries a singular Hermitian metric with semi-positive curvature current). After replacing $X$ by a suitable finite étale cover, consider the Albanese map $\alpha\colon X \to \mathrm{Alb}(X)$, and let $F$ denote a general fiber of $\alpha$.

(a) Prove or disprove: the anti-canonical divisor $-K_F$ is big, or $F$ is projective.

(b) Prove or disprove: the Albanese map $\alpha\colon X \to \mathrm{Alb}(X)$ is a maximally rationally connected (MRC) fibration of $X$ (that is, its general fibers are rationally connected and any rational curve in $X$ meeting a general fiber is contained in it).
artifact.category_tag: Pseudo-effective tangent bundles on Kähler manifolds
artifact.status_search_result: The projective case has structure results (smooth fibration onto a flat projective manifold with rationally connected fibers), and partial results exist in the Kähler setting (e.g., for threefolds with nef anti-canonical bundle and recent work on Albanese maps for Kähler manifolds with nef anticanonical bundle). However, no source found establishes the full statement for arbitrary compact Kähler manifolds with pseudo-effective tangent bundle, so the problem appears to remain open in this generality.

status_evidence.title: On projective manifolds with pseudo-effective tangent bundle
status_evidence.snippet: Structure theorem for projective manifolds with pseudo-effective tangent bundle: smooth fibration to flat projective manifold with rationally connected general fiber.
status_evidence.claim: Projective case has a known structure theorem; Kähler case in full generality not addressed.

status_evidence.title: Albanese map for Kähler manifolds with nef anticanonical bundle
status_evidence.snippet: Recent (2025) work analyzing the Albanese map under the weaker condition of nef anticanonical bundle.
status_evidence.claim: Active research on Albanese maps under positivity hypotheses; the pseudo-effective tangent bundle Kähler case remains a continuing line of research.

status_evidence.title: Compact Kähler three-folds with nef anti-canonical bundle
status_evidence.snippet: For threefolds, MRC fibration factors through Albanese map.
